conflicts.permit: When you use our Services, e.g. play our games, we can automatically collect technical information about your IP address, promotional identifiers, equipment, browsing actions and models you use, as well as statistics.
conflicts.prohibit: Under no circumstance will Tap Tap Tales collect personal information from children.
conflicts.situation: A child plays Tap Tap Tales games (which are explicitly aimed at children under 13).
conflicts.reason: One clause flatly prohibits collecting personal information from children under any circumstance, while another states IP addresses and promotional identifiers (personal data) are automatically collected during gameplay.
